sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: At Scryved, we collect information that you provide directly when you use our services, such as when you fill out a contact form, request a quote, or contact us for support. This information may include your name, email address, phone number, and project details.

sections.title: 2. Use of Information
sections.content: We use the information we collect to:
list: Provide, operate, and maintain our services.
Improve, personalize, and expand our services.
Understand and analyze how you use our services.
Develop new products, services, features, and functionality.
Communicate with you for customer service.

sections.title: 3. Log Files
sections.content: Scryved follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected includes IP addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, and referring/exit pages.

sections.title: 4. Cookies
sections.content: Like any other website, Scryved uses 'cookies'. These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed. The information is used to optimize the users' experience by customizing content.

sections.title: 5. Contact
sections.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at: scryved@gmail.com
